command_summary: claude --print --permission-mode plan --tools Read,Grep,Glob --no-session-persistence --no-chrome --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources project --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort medium

style_authority.note: Design read restates the calm, repeated-use operations context and ties choices to it (e.g. damping 1.0 spring 'no bounce, matching the calm style'). Component role is clear, though motion policy is checked mostly implicitly rather than as an explicit authority step.

reference_selection.note: Names SKILL.md and references/interaction-physics.md and visibly applies them (decay-rate projection, rubber-band formula, critically damped spring). No visible design-system or validation reference is cited, so not full credit.

anti_generic_redesign.note: 'Yes, but only two motions are justified' plus an explicit do-not-animate list (press scale, transition: all, content scaling, bounce/overshoot, input lock). Clearly treats less motion as the goal.

evidence_level.note: States 'static only' and separates findings 'Inferred from the WAAPI and CSS specs, not observed' (frozen sheet, ~300 ms trailing, per-frame layout). F5's 'forces a layout recalculation on every frame' is phrased as fact in the table, but the verified section downgrades it to inferred.

verified_boundary.note: Clean three-tier split (verified from source / inferred from spec / unverified runtime). The unverified list does not explicitly name Reduced Motion behavior or focus/interruption outcomes, which appear only in the validation plan.

design_moves.note: M1-M8 map one-to-one to the requested moves with concrete mechanics: setPointerCapture + grabOffset, translateY per rAF, presentation-value interruption, ~100 ms velocity window, projection with d≈0.99, rubber-band formula, and hysteresis. Explicitly removes transition: all.

scope_control.note: 84 lines, five blocking findings, eight moves, all within limits and on motion behavior. The ten-step validation plan is somewhat long for a 'minimal' plan.
